title: Are you wanting a house close to shopping? Then this is the ONE!
description:
Property Site: https://view.paradym.com/v/2001-Grey-Fox-Trail-Killeen-TX-76543/4374491

2001 Grey Fox Trail
Killeen, TX 76543
$169,900, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,528 SF, MLS# 385240

Are you wanting a house close to shopping? Then this is the ONE! The beautifully landscaped and maintained home is exactly what you have been searching for! There are 2528 sq ft just waiting for you to fill. From the wide tiled entry to the high ceilings and recessed lighting, you are bound to fall in love. Office area has brown elegant, carved wood walls, a large mirror, and an artist desk. The master bedroom is just as unique as the rest of the house including a separate sitting area, walk-in closet, and private access to the backyard. Let's talk kitchen; featuring ample storage space, tile floors, center island and lot's of windows to bring in wonderful lighting. Outback there is plenty of space for any size patio furniture, storage building, and with a playground right next door, there is no need to clutter the spacious backyard with a playscape! Schedule your appointment today!
